title: UserProvisioningDeleteRequestDataType
description: Schema for a UserProvisioning delete request payload. Accepts either the direct payload or a wrapper object with property 'deleteUserType'.

idpUserId.description: IDP_UserID. This identifies the user at the service provider and must start with 'IDP'.

deletionDate.description: Time at which the user was deleted from EcoHub (date and time down to milliseconds, time zone independent).

deletionUser.description: Name/ID of the user who deleted the user on EcoHub; must start with 'IDP' when using an ID value.

requestTime.description: Time of the request as timestamp.
